# app/controllers/api/v1/proxy_controller.rb
class Api::V1::ProxyController < ApplicationController
  skip_before_action :verify_authenticity_token

  # Internal microservice proxy - forwards requests to backend services
  def forward
    target_host = params[:service] || 'backend-api'
    target_path = params[:path] || '/'
    
    # Build the raw HTTP request to forward
    body = request.raw_post
    content_length = body.bytesize
    
    # Construct HTTP/1.1 request manually for performance
    raw_request = "POST #{target_path} HTTP/1.1\r\n"
    raw_request += "Host: #{target_host}\r\n"
    
    # Forward original headers
    request.headers.each do |key, value|
      next unless key.start_with?('HTTP_')
      header_name = key.sub('HTTP_', '').split('_').map(&:capitalize).join('-')
      next if header_name == 'Host'
      # Allow Transfer-Encoding for chunked uploads
      raw_request += "#{header_name}: #{value}\r\n"
    end
    
    # Add Content-Length based on actual body
    raw_request += "Content-Length: #{content_length}\r\n"
    raw_request += "Connection: keep-alive\r\n"
    raw_request += "\r\n"
    raw_request += body
    
    # Send via persistent TCP connection pool
    response_data = ConnectionPool.forward_raw(target_host, 8080, raw_request)
    
    render plain: response_data, status: :ok
  end

  def health
    render json: { status: 'ok', pid: Process.pid, root: Dir.pwd }
  end
end

# lib/connection_pool.rb
class ConnectionPool
  @connections = {}
  @mutex = Mutex.new

  def self.forward_raw(host, port, raw_request)
    socket = get_or_create(host, port)
    socket.write(raw_request)
    
    # Read response (simplified - reads until connection idle)
    response = ''
    begin
      loop do
        chunk = socket.read_nonblock(4096)
        response += chunk
      end
    rescue IO::WaitReadable
      IO.select([socket], nil, nil, 2)
      retry if response.empty?
    rescue EOFError
      @mutex.synchronize { @connections.delete("#{host}:#{port}") }
    end
    response
  end

  def self.get_or_create(host, port)
    key = "#{host}:#{port}"
    @mutex.synchronize do
      if @connections[key]&.closed?
        @connections.delete(key)
      end
      @connections[key] ||= TCPSocket.new(host, port)
    end
  end
end

environment.description: Identical Rails application deployed in a hardened container runtime. The process is confined via pivot_root(2) into /srv/app/jail which contains only the application code, Ruby runtime, and gem dependencies. The jail directory has no /etc/passwd, no /proc mount, no socket files, and no sensitive configuration. Additionally, the container uses a read-only root filesystem overlay with tmpfs only at /tmp (noexec,nosuid,size=10m). The Puma workers are further isolated with a seccomp-bpf profile that permits socket(AF_INET) but restricts connect(2) syscalls to destinations matching 10.0.5.0/24 subnet only via a SECCOMP_RET_ERRNO filter — the backend-api service resides at 10.0.5.10 but admin-service is at 10.0.8.5 and user-data is at 10.0.8.12. Network namespace has no route to 10.0.8.0/24.
